The challenges become more and more difficult as you progress and some may need to change your perspective as well. Try to score as much as you can before the time runs out and then try again to beat your high score or be at the top of the leaderboard. The grid is also mobile friendly which only requires click / tap controls.

The player achieves their highest score by consecutively popping large matching clusters. They receive ten times the standard allotment of points when they pop avalanches of non-matched bubbles with a cluster and double their score when they clear the field entirely.
